programme.title: Coolie: The Powerhouse
programme.desc: Deva learns his friend Rajshekar was murdered and discovers a chair that turns bodies to ash. With Preeti, he exposes smuggling ring and seeks justice.

programme.title: Raju Chacha
programme.desc: Raju is hired to pose as the uncle of three orphans to claim their inheritance, but after falling in love with their governess, he decides to protect the children from greedy relatives.

programme.title: Tu Hai Mera Sunday
programme.desc: A group of five friends finds it hard to play football in the busy and overpopulated Mumbai city after a local politician bans playing any kind of sport on the beach.

programme.title: Wah ! Tera Kya Kehna
programme.desc: Dilip and Ashish plan to prove that their brother Raj is mentally incompetent to inherit their father Kishan Oberoi's property. However, Raj's lookalike takes his place and reaps the benefits.

programme.title: Albela
programme.desc: Tony, a tour guide, falls in love with his client Sonia. He tries to woo her, but she does not reciprocate his feelings since she loves another man.

programme.title: Aunty No. 1
programme.desc: When Gopi is asked to pretend to his friend Aunt, he doesn't realize the mess he will get into when the real Aunt shows up.

programme.title: Kyo Kii Main Jhuth Nahi Bolta
programme.desc: Raj is a lawyer who finds great success through his habit of lying. However, when his son wishes for his father to stop lying, Raj is magically forced to speak the truth and gets into trouble.

programme.title: Baaghi 3
programme.desc: Ronnie, a young man, shares a deep bond with Vikram, his elder brother and a policeman. When Vikram gets kidnapped in Syria while on a mission, Ronnie sets out to rescue him.

programme.title: Jaane Jaan
programme.desc: Maya D'Souza is a divorced, single mother who runs a cafeteria. Naren Vyas is a reclusive, but brilliant mathematics teacher, who lives next door to Maya and her teenage daughter Tara.

programme.title: Patiala House
programme.desc: A victim Rishi Kapoor of British racial violence and profiling prevents his son Akshay Kumar from playing cricket for an English team. The film also stars Anushka Sharma.

programme.title: Kya Love Story Hai
programme.desc: A carefree youth, Arjun, falls in love with Kaajal who sees her ideal man in Ranveer, a hard-working and focused guy.

programme.title: Raja Babu
programme.desc: Raja an orphan, is adopted by a rich village couple. Later, he falls in love with a city girl. But she walks out on him on after learning that he is not as sophisticated as he portrays himself to be.

programme.title: Hadh Kar Di Aapne
programme.desc: Two travelers mistaken for a married couple fall in love amid chaos. Packed with situational humor and romance, it's a delightful comedy about destiny and unexpected connections.

programme.title: Bhagam Bhaag
programme.desc: Bunty, Babla and Champak get trapped in a chaotic adventure involving gangsters, stolen money and nonstop confusion filled with comedy and madness.

programme.title: Partner
programme.desc: Prem, a love guru who shares tips on dating women, helps his client, Bhaskar, woo his boss. However, he later falls for a single mother and tries to hide his profession.

programme.title: Chak De India
programme.desc: Kabir Khan, disgraced ex-captain, coaches the struggling Indian Women's Hockey team. He aims to unite them, instilling pride and belief to achieve victory for India.

programme.title: Kaala Karikalan
programme.desc: Karikaalan, a resident of Dharavi, unites the people living in his area to stand up against Hari Bhau, a ruthless politician, who dreams of taking over their land.

programme.title: Chaloo
programme.desc: Khoji claims to be the director of a film when he is arrested by PI Khan for selling movie tickets in black. Is he really the film's director.

programme.title: Bad Newz
programme.desc: A woman faces pregnancy dilemmas when she discovers she is pregnant by two different men.

programme.title: Hello Brother
programme.desc: Two brothers-one living, one a ghost-team up to fight a crime lord. Filled with comedy, emotion, and music, it's a lighthearted tale of brotherhood and unfinished business from beyond.

programme.title: Bachna Ae Haseeno
programme.desc: Raj, a notorious playboy known for breaking hearts, learns a lesson when his true love, Gayatri, rejects him. He, then, sets out to earn the forgiveness of his former conquests and win Gayatri back.

programme.title: Ishq
programme.desc: Four lovers from different backgrounds fight family opposition in a blend of comedy, drama, and emotion. Their misadventures highlight love's madness and the joy of rebellion.

programme.title: Jayeshbhai Jordaar
programme.desc: A compassionate man fights societal pressure to save his unborn daughter. Mixing humor and emotion, it delivers a powerful message about gender equality and the courage to challenge norms.

programme.title: Laxmii
programme.desc: Aasif's belief in logic and science shatters when he gets possessed by a ghost. What starts as a comical journey soon unearths a dark secret.

programme.title: Vijay The Master
programme.desc: A professor with a drinking problem goes to a school for young people. He argues with a criminal who uses the students for illegal things.

programme.title: Hulla
programme.desc: Raj and his wife expect peace in the their new flat. But thanks to the watchman's whistle Raj becomes sleep-deprived.

programme.title: Munna Michael
programme.desc: Michael, an aging dancer, finds purpose raising an abandoned baby, Munna, who dreams of dancing. Together, they navigate challenges, gangsters, and the quest for love.

programme.title: MS Dhoni - The Untold Story
programme.desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

programme.title: Bhoothnath Returns
programme.desc: Bhoothnath returns from the afterlife to contest elections, fighting corruption and inspiring change. Mixing comedy, fantasy, and social satire, it delivers a heartfelt message of honesty and hope.

programme.title: Singham Returns

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Colombia v Ghana
programme.desc: Colombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure

programme.title: Nations Championship

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Canada v Morocco
programme.desc: Canada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Cameras venture underwater with a whitetip reef shark and a pelagic thresher shark as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Footage of one of the most dramatic moments in nature - a predator claiming its prey, revealing how these creatures have adapted to achieve epic feats of speed, cunning and agility.

programme.title: Accidental Wilderness: Europe's Everglades
programme.desc: Documentary about a former wasteland in the middle of Europe where wastewater used to be deposited, which is now a paradise for birds migrating from across the continent and beyond.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals
programme.desc: Watch the team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, before continuing to track Badalo - who has moved deeper into the flooded forest.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Cameras venture underwater with a whitetip reef shark and a pelagic thresher shark as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts.

programme.title: Superbeast
programme.desc: A celebration of nature's ultimate athletes as they survive, excel and dominate in Earth's toughest arenas, from apex predators to cunning creatures. Gorillas smash termite mounds to pieces, jaguars crack the skulls of caimans with apparent ease, and orcas hunt their prey as a team.

programme.title: Nature's Dress Code: Who Wears What and Why?
programme.desc: Every living creature, from the amoeba to the blue whale, needs a suitable coat. Dive deep into the fashion styles of the natural world with this colourful documentary.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue
programme.desc: The wildlife of the Three Kings Islands, a group of 13 uninhabited islands near New Zealand, which includes bottlenose dolphins, predatory orcas and short-tailed stingrays.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue
programme.desc: Journey to the Cook Islands as 3,000 humpback whales get ready to mate and raise their young. Plus, a glimpse into evolutionary past.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: A look at how, to survive Australia's hostile landscapes, animal inhabitants must always have a plan. They all rely on strategic behaviour to thrive.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: A look at the cannibalistic spider crab and venom-sporting platypus - proof that nowhere does strange quite like Australia.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: How, in the land down under, each moment is a battle of survival and to see another day, animals must be bold, courageous and totally fearless.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Wallabies bravely scale the terrain and Turkey dads defend their nests. They prove that having a tenacious attitude is the key to overcoming the odds.

programme.title: My Best Friend's an Animal
programme.desc: Meeting Penny the pigeon and the human who saved her and diving with a shark dancer. Plus, Riana and her lifelong commitment to Faith the cheetah.

programme.title: My Best Friend's an Animal
programme.desc: An invasive nutria has become part of a human family, Gumbo the goose enjoys a paddle in the pool and a swimmer shares their bond with wild grey seals.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: A look at the different types of sharks that live in earth's oceans, while cameras follow a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway
programme.desc: Tracking a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef, before searching for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Documentary taking a look at the intertidal zone, the point at which the ocean meets the land, and the struggle for survival facing the creatures that inhabit this realm. Their success is critical, because this is one of the most important habitats on the planet - a vital connection between worlds.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Documentary exploring how life manages to exist in the world's varied habitats, beginning with a new species perfectly suited to inhabit the mighty Drakensberg, one of South Africa's most impressive landscapes.

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Tanzania's Lake Manyara National Park, an area enriched by ancient volcanos which provides a variety of habitats for life to thrive.

programme.title: My Wild Cats
programme.desc: Observing five unique feline species as they try to make a comeback in the wild.

programme.title: My Wild Cats

programme.desc: Part one of two. Beech goes missing just as his corrupt past casts its shadow over the rest of CID. As the net tightens Stanton is revealed as an internal investigations mole, working at Sun Hill with Brownlow's blessing. Billy Murray stars.

programme.title: Classic EastEnders
programme.desc: Kat and Alfie hold their Countdown to Christmas party - but who will be caught secretly kissing Santa beneath the tree? Pat implores a suspicious Janine to trust her husband.

programme.title: Classic EastEnders
programme.desc: As Janine prepares for her perfect Christmas, a conflicted Pat wrestles with a secret that could destroy her marriage. Ryan struggles to contain a volatile Whitney.

programme.title: Tenko
programme.desc: Marion and Dorothy have very different experience when they finally return to their homes. Drama about a group of women, formerly comfortably well-off expats living in Singapore, forced to endure the horrifying conditions of a Japanese prison camp during the Second World War.

programme.title: Pie in the Sky
programme.desc: Crabbe is ordered to track down two OAP fraudsters - but he seems more interested in getting his hands on their recipe for bread-and-butter pudding. Being lumbered with a temporary partner only complicates matters for the cuisine-loving policeman, and leads to friction with Cambridge. Guest starring Joan Sims, with Richard Griffiths and Maggie Steed.

programme.title: Lovejoy
programme.desc: Snooker player Dennis Taylor asks Lovejoy for help finding a billiards table that once belonged to Mary Queen of Scots. Drama, also starring Ian McShane.

programme.title: Waiting for God
programme.desc: After moving into a double room, Tom and Diana bicker about whose furniture they should use. Comedy, starring Stephanie Cole and Graham Crowden.

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.desc: Clegg, Truly, Alvin and Billy encounter a stranger who is determined to travel by canal to Ilkley in an inflatable swan. However, when punctures disrupt the man's dream, Entwistle is on hand to ensure the voyage goes to plan. Tommy Cannon and Bobby Ball guest star.

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.desc: Clegg climbs a tree to prove a point, but finds getting down is not as easy. Meanwhile, the police investigate the case of a runaway cooker. Comedy, starring Peter Sallis.

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.sub-title: Has Anyone Seen a Peruvian Wart?
programme.desc: Roy Barraclough guest stars as Crowcroft, a well-known Lothario with a preference for gullible women. When he samples Nora Batty's baking, he decides to make her his next target. Long-running comedy, with Kathy Staff, Peter Sallis and Frank Thornton.

programme.title: 'Allo 'Allo!
programme.desc: Gruber rescues René from his cell, while Herr Flick orders Helga to collect evidence of the supposed plot to blow up Hitler.

programme.title: 'Allo 'Allo!
programme.desc: René and his staff devise a plan whereby Leclerc can enter Gruber's room disguised as a fireman to create a diversion so they can blow up the safe.

programme.title: 'Allo 'Allo!
programme.desc: Rene and Leclerc crack open the safe in Lieutenant Gruber's bedroom, but instead of the plans for the invasion of England, they discover two original paintings. The pair make a bid to escape with the artwork, only to be taken prisoner by the Communist Resistance. Gorden Kaye and Jack Haig star.

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: Part two of two. Danny takes Gerry on the run as they search for the proof they need to prove his innocence - despite Gerry remaining tight-lipped about his involvement with dodgy dealings in his old unit. The stakes are high as the Unsolved Crime and Open Case Squad goes after one of the biggest crime families in London, and it's those closest to Gerry who are dangerously put in the firing line. Starring Dennis Waterman, Nicholas Lyndhurst, Tamzin Outhwaite and Denis Lawson.

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Feature-length episode. Nikki is asked to give evidence at the appeal of convicted murderer David Bennetto, and when her testimony leads to his release, she ends up locking horns with DI Rachel Klein, who put the man away six years earlier. It seems the detective is right when another young man is found dead at the scene of the original crime. Has Nikki helped to free a serial killer? Emilia Fox stars, with appearances from Tobias Menzies, Michael Socha and Aaron McCusker.

programme.title: Amerigo
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the past, present and future of the American Dream, featuring interviews with everyday Americans exploring immigration, housing, healthcare, protest, technology, media, art and more.

programme.title: Tina
programme.desc: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome. Following a prolonged period of ill health, Turner intends to retire from the spotlight with her second husband, Erwin Bach. She bids farewell to her fans in the emotional documentary Tina. Directed by Dan Lindsay and TJ Martin, the film invites the singer to reminisce about her turbulent life and career with glowing contributions from friends, family and fans including Oprah Winfrey and Angela Bassett.

programme.title: I Am Richard Pryor
programme.desc: Documentary reflecting on the highs and lows of the comedian and actor's life, featuring interviews with Mike Epps, Tiffany Haddish and his widow Jennifer Lee.

programme.title: On the Line: The Richard Williams Story
programme.desc: Featuring newly uncovered interviews spanning the 1980s to now, Richard Williams - the father of tennis stars Venus and Serena - retraces his family's journey from the poverty-stricken streets of Shreveport, Louisiana, to the grass courts of Wimbledon.

programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Devta

programme.title: Mera Faisla

programme.title: Majaal

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln and Clyde overwater Howard's rare orchid in 'The Orchid Grief', and in 'Forks and Knives Out', Lynn Sr. is stoked to compete on a cooking show until he learns he's up against Rosa.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Luna and the Moon Goats have to find a replacement guitarist in 'Music To My Fears', then in 'Fluff and Foiled', Lincoln is determined to get laundry duty finished as fast as possible.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: The Louds gather ingredients for an italian chef in 'Nonna Your Business', and the road trip continues in 'Alpining Away', when Lynn crushes on a boy.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln avoids his chores in a high-tech way in 'Hologram Jam', then in 'Sick as a Dad', the Loud siblings are tasked with taking care of Dad when he overreacts to getting a cold.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln is going to his first rock concert in 'For Bros About to Rock', then in 'It's a Loud, Loud, Loud, Loud House', Lincoln finds a letter suggesting there is money hidden in the house.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Mom and Dad win a trip to a resort and decide to take the kids in 'Suite and Sour', then in 'Back in Black', when Lucy gets a crush on a regular normal boy, her sisters give her a makeover.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Dad and Lincoln get on Legends of the Hidden Temple in 'Legends', and in 'Mall of Duty', Lincoln wants to go to the mall but has to watch his younger sisters, so he takes them to the mall.

programme.desc: Lana learns her favourite fish are in jeopardy in 'Scales of Justice', then in 'Crimes of Fashion', Leni gets fired from her job, so Lincoln and Clyde (as Ace and Jack) take on the case.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln worries that his friend group is splintering in 'Friends in Dry Places', then in 'Coupe Dreams', in order to buy her dream car, Lori becomes a local rideshare driver.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Luna is worried about her friends seeing her perform in 'Dad Reputation', then in 'Dream a Lily Dream', Lisa discovers the only way to stop Lily's nightmares is to go inside her dreams.

programme.desc: The kids try to make Chef Guy Grazer a meal in 'Dine and Bash', then in 'Sofa, So Good', the kids search all over Royal Woods to find the missing furniture they left outside while cleaning.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lori struggles to make a good impression in 'Day of the Dad', then in 'Small Blunder', desperate to have the best show-and-tell in class, Lily takes Lisa's shrink ray to school.

programme.title: The Loud House

programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: The sisters think Lincoln is bad luck in 'No Such Luck', and in 'Frog Wild', when Lincoln finds out his class is dissecting frogs, he and Lana embark on a mission to rescue them.

programme.title: The Loud House

programme.title: The Loud House

programme.title: The Loud House

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: It's five years since Sophie invited her three possible dads to her wedding, and now most of her family are reunited as she prepares for the grand reopening of the Hotel Bella Donna. Along the way, she learns more about her mother's past. Abba-themed musical sequel, starring Amanda Seyfried, Lily James, Pierce Brosnan, Cher and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Central Intelligence
programme.desc: Action comedy, starring Dwayne Johnson as a one-time geek who suffered constant humiliation at high school but grew up to be a lethal CIA agent. But when he is targeted by his own organisation, he comes home for a high school reunion, where he enlists the help of the former campus tough guy - now a meek accountant - who very quickly wonders what he has got himself into. Co-starring Kevin Hart and Amy Ryan.

programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
programme.desc: Cute furball Gizmo is reunited with his human friends Billy and Kate, who now work in the New York offices of an eccentric tycoon. However, it is not long before Gizmo has spawned a new generation of murderous carnivores, who quickly overrun the building - and a genetics lab where they produce even more startling mutations. Joe Dante's comedy sequel, starring Zach Galligan, Phoebe Cates, John Glover and Christopher Lee.

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: A family tragedy woos Delia Deetz, daughter Lydia and rebellious teenage granddaughter Astrid back to the close-knit community of Winter River. Astrid accidentally opens a portal to the afterlife by summoning Beetlejuice three times. The mischievous demon ricochets between realms, wreaking havoc wherever he goes. Tim Burton's comedy sequel, starring Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder and Jenna Ortega.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Under heavy pressure from her father, Beca reluctantly starts her first year at Barden University and gets an internship at the school radio station. She soon acquires a new circle of friends in the form of a band of misfits with a shared talent for singing, joining their a cappella group and trying to inject some much needed energy into their repertoire. Comedy, starring Anna Kendrick, Brittany Snow, Anna Camp, Rebel Wilson and Skylar Astin.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: A Cappella group the Barden Bellas enjoy an unprecedented run of success, until a disastrous performance sees them banned from national competitions and beset by scandal. They attempt to turn their fortunes around and redeem their reputation by competing in the World Championships of A Cappella in Copenhagen. Comedy sequel, starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: A widowed father is coping badly with his wife's death, but his son is convinced that what he really needs is some new romance in his life. He arranges for his dad to go on a radio phone-in show, and his touching story moves a reporter to respond, even though she is already engaged. She returns to her fiance, but the boy, certain she is the woman for his father, plots to bring them together. Romantic comedy, with Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Recently widowed Bridget enters the dating game once again, caught between her son's science teacher and a man 20 years her junior. Romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Hugh Grant, Leo Woodall and Colin Firth.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Two teenage friends are on the brink of going to different colleges, so decide to mark the event by going to a party where they hope to lose their virginity. However, they have promised to supply the booze for the event, a task that proves much harder than expected because they are under age. Unfortunately, when a friend steps in to help, the situation gets even worse. Comedy, starring Jonah Hill, Michael Cera and Christopher Mintz-Plasse.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's The Tuxedo
programme.desc: A bumbling chauffeur steps in to take the place of a secret agent injured in an explosion. Wearing the agent's hi-tech suit, and with the help of a rookie spy, the humble driver now has all the power he needs to stop a villain from gaining global domination by polluting the world's water supply. Comedy adventure, starring Jackie Chan, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Jason Isaacs and Richie Coster.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Three former opera singers prepare for their annual concert to mark Verdi's birthday and raise funds for their retirement home. However, this year, a famous diva has joined the group, and her history with the others threatens the performance. Comedy drama, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Billy Connolly, Tom Courtenay, Pauline Collins and Michael Gambon.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: A widowed father is coping badly with his wife's death, but his son is convinced that what he really needs is some new romance in his life. He arranges for his dad to go on a radio phone-in show, and his touching story moves a reporter to respond, even though she is already engaged. She returns to her fiance, but the boy, certain she is the woman for his father, plots to bring them together. Romantic comedy, with Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A writer struggling to complete the script for a movie about psychopathic killers turns to his criminal friends for advice. He ends up getting more than he bargained for when the small-time crooks kidnap a dog that belongs to a gangster, putting all their lives in danger. Comedy thriller, starring Colin Farrell, Sam Rockwell, Christopher Walken and Woody Harrelson.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
programme.desc: A bumbling all-American family man takes his wife and kids on a disaster-filled cross-country drive to California to visit famous theme park Walley World - but their chances of arriving at their destination in one piece are looking slim. Comedy, starring Chevy Chase, Beverly D'Angelo, Randy Quaid, Imogene Coca, Anthony Michael Hall, Christie Brinkley and John Candy.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: While investigating the shooting of a colleague, disaster-prone police lieutenant Frank Drebin uncovers a plot to assassinate the Queen during her visit to Los Angeles. However, after he is sacked from the force by the mayor, the cop has to operate beneath the radar to get to the bottom of the conspiracy. Comedy, with Leslie Nielsen, Priscilla Presley and Ricardo Montalban.

programme.title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
programme.desc: Blundering cop Frank Drebin discovers a secret conspiracy to kidnap a renowned solar energy expert and replace him with an imposter. As he sets out to bring the perpetrators to justice, he is unexpectedly reunited with an old flame. Slapstick comedy sequel, starring Leslie Nielsen, Priscilla Presley, George Kennedy, Richard Griffiths and OJ Simpson.

programme.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
programme.desc: Inept police detective Frank Drebin plans to retire from the force, but is lured back by the opportunity to foil a terrorist plot. Going undercover in prison, he sets out to prevent an evil mastermind from escaping and carrying out his fiendish plan - to bomb the Oscar awards ceremony. Comedy sequel, starring Leslie Nielsen, Priscilla Presley, OJ Simpson, George Kennedy and Fred Ward.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Recently widowed Bridget enters the dating game once again, caught between her son's science teacher and a man 20 years her junior. Romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Hugh Grant, Leo Woodall and Colin Firth.

programme.title: Singin' in the Rain
programme.desc: A silent-movie star tries to win the heart of an aspiring actress as the introduction of sound changes the film business for ever. However, his frequent on-screen love interest does not take kindly to this real-life romance. Musical comedy, starring Gene Kelly, Debbie Reynolds, Donald O'Connor, Jean Hagen and Millard Mitchell. Songs include Make 'em Laugh, You Are My Lucky Star and the title number.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Two rivals in the bookshop business fall in love over the internet, unaware they know and dislike each other in the real world. While things remain frosty in person, the pair's anonymous online relationship continues to blossom. Romantic comedy, starring Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Greg Kinnear, Parker Posey and Dabney Coleman.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Nurse Greg is now the proud father of twins, but has yet to earn the respect of his wife's stern father after 10 years of marriage. The couple invite both sides of their extended family to the kids' birthday party, where Greg makes a desperate effort to finally prove his worth to his father-in-law. Comedy sequel, with Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Owen Wilson and Dustin Hoffman.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: A lawyer whose underhand ploys to win cases leave him little time to see his son discovers he is incapable of lying after the boy's birthday wish makes his dad tell only the truth. However, this causes a host of problems as the attorney tries to muddle his way through a high-profile divorce settlement. programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: A reformed criminal mastermind who has abandoned his wicked ways for a life of fatherhood and jam-making helps a secret agent to bring one of his fellow evil geniuses to justice. The villain in question has stolen a dangerous experimental serum with the power to turn harmless animals into ravening monsters. Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Dismissed from the Anti-Villain League after botching a mission, Gru sets off to meet his long-lost twin brother for one final criminal mission. Animated sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig, Trey Parker and Miranda Cosgrove.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: A race of strange, babbling yellow creatures has served the cause of evil throughout the history of the world. In the 1960s, three of these eternal henchmen get a job working for a criminal genius who is hatching a plot against the British crown - but while carrying out her orders, they uncover a threat to their whole species. Animated comedy, with the voices of Sandra Bullock, Pierre Coffin, Jon Hamm and Michael Keaton.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind hopes to seal his reputation as the greatest villain of them all by stealing the Moon. First he needs to get his hands on a shrinking ray owned by a rival evil genius, and adopts three orphan girls to help him - but finds that fatherhood brings out his long-buried caring side. Animated comedy, with the voices of Steve Carell, Jason Segel, Russell Brand and Julie Andrews.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.
